{state_list}

## Sizes

Each symbol is provided as raster template PNG scale variants: 24pt at 1x/2x/3x (24, 48, 72px) for general buttons, toolbars, and list rows, plus 25pt at 1x/2x/3x (25, 50, 75px) for tab-bar-style glyphs.

## Recommended use

Use these transparent monochrome PNGs as fallback template images for iOS tab bars, toolbars, buttons, and list rows when SF Symbols is not enough or when a custom product-specific glyph is required. Prefer tint/template rendering in the app so the system can adapt the symbol to selected, disabled, light, dark, and accessibility states.

For a production-grade custom SF Symbol, use Apple's SF Symbols SVG-template workflow instead of raster PNGs. This bundle provides PNG assets only.

Do not use this pack as Home Screen launcher icons. For launcher tiles, use `app-icons` or `app-icon-set` instead.

All files are PNG with transparent backgrounds. {file_count} files total.
